items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He played with Erskine Tate; he played with Carroll Dickerson.

ctx.x: He played with Erskine Tate; he played with Carroll Dickerson. It's impossible for anybody to take the tympanis the way they were and set up and play "I'm Forever Blowing Bubbles". That's when Red Nichols and other peoples were playing - Red Nichols was keeping his little jazz alive and they had this drummer, talking about how great he was, but they had to come from across the tracks to learn from him -
He was one of the first really versatile drummers. He played drums, xylophone -
